title: ScreenplayStoryBible
description: Phase 02 characters and backstory. Tier 1 pure markdown. slot/status are managed by dl artifact itself. Content has one field, story_bible (markdown body with protagonist cards / relationships / world entry point).

story_bible.description: Complete character bible markdown: protagonist cards (name / want / need / arc / contradiction / basic_info visual anchor) + relationships (optional) + world entry point. Downstream Phase 05 uses character names appearing in the markdown as dialogue-name anchors, so they must remain consistent.
